note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative: the contract, its clause lines and the claim are generic placeholders, never real contract text or real claims. The relations are drawn only as supplied (plain lines; an arrow only for a supplied sequence or causal kind). "Claim covered as per supplied data" and "Scope disputed (as supplied)" are supplied statuses of equal weight (● and ◆ of the same area; the scope collar has the same colour and width, solid or dashed). No indemnity doctrine is stated: no duty to indemnify or pay, no decision on cover beyond the supplied datum, no amount unless supplied (always labelled hypothetical), no outcome and no jurisdiction; "scope disputed" stays an allegation. Brief customizable fields not exposed (coordinator decision BRIEF CUSTOMIZABLE FIELDS, SESSION_HANDOFF 2026-10-05): schedules, definitions, priorities, actorLabels (no actor in this treatment) and annotations; objectLabels = the components' name tabs (elements); clauses = the supplied clause lines, promise = the line the film registers on.
